capabilities.name: mcp

permissions.reason: Read vendored/generated skill metadata, references, and user input paths.
Write generated handoff, provenance, audit, and dry-run artifacts.
Optional public scientific database/paper/API lookup after per-skill trust.
Optional remote job submission or mutation only after explicit trust and confirmation.
Optional upstream script execution; blocked by default until explicitly reviewed.
Service-specific lab data mutations require explicit trust.
Cloud genomics platform mutations require explicit trust.
Cloud compute execution requires explicit trust.
Physical lab automation execution requires explicit trust.
Reference library mutations require explicit trust.
